hints.title: Alternating Parity Sign
hints.text: Elements at even indices are added, while elements at odd indices are subtracted.

hints.title: Toggle Multiplier
hints.text: Maintain a sign variable initialized to 1, and negate it after processing each element.

hints.title: Direct Linear Scan
hints.text: Iterate sequentially through the array accumulating the signed values.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building separate positive and negative subarrays requires extra memory allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simple clean loop with alternating sign multiplier.
